steps.title: Step 3

A new row is automatically inserted into the Enquiries Google Sheet — no coordinator needed to manually type this.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.description: Sheet Updated — ZoAi Triggers Delivery Suresh Patil approves the quote in the ZoTok admin portal. The sheet status updates to "Quote Approved", Quote No QT-2026-01129 is written, and the PDF URL is attached. ZoAi detects this status change via a sheet webhook and immediately prepares to send the quote PDF back into the customer group.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.description: Order Confirmed — Full Cycle Complete Rajesh types the confirmation keyword in the group. ZoAi detects it, logs the order confirmation against QT-2026-01129, updates the sheet status to "Booking In Progress", and replies in the group. From free-text enquiry to confirmed order — entirely within WhatsApp, with minimal team effort.
